intro: Cry of the Thunderhawk is the culmination of Jorn Skyseer's hunting trials in the southern Barrens. Entrusted by the elders at Camp Taurajo, a hunter must seek out a winged serpent soaring through the scrublands and bring back its wings to prove their mastery over the savanna's fiercest beasts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The thunderhawk, friend, is a fierce beast. It is time for you to face them. You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.
Do this, and your time with me will near its end.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud. You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.
But your path, friend, continues. In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.
Now, it is time to move on.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
